decisions.evidence: Taken together, all three positive neighbors and all three negative neighbors point in the same direction: the recurring absence/presence pattern around 1,3-dioxolane, along with ketone differences, ring counts, and in several cases higher TPSA or lower logP, is more consistent with option (A), not a substrate to the enzyme CYP3A4, than with a substrate assignment. The net comparison therefore supports the non-substrate label.
